title: Design Your First Magnet Frame in TinkerCAD
description: Step-by-step TinkerCAD tutorial: building a 4x3 photo magnet frame with integrated magnet slots

actions.description: Start with blank page for title

actions.script:
document.body.style.cssText = 'margin:0; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0A0A0F 0%, #1a1a2e 50%, #16213e 100%); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 100vh; font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, sans-serif;'; document.body.innerHTML = '
3D PRINT ACADEMY — MODULE 2, LESSON 2
Design Your First
Magnet Frame
Step-by-Step TinkerCAD Tutorial
';

actions.text: Step 1: Open TinkerCAD and Create a New Design
The TinkerCAD workspace — your 3D design canvas

actions.script:
document.body.style.cssText = 'margin:0; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0A0A0F 0%, #1a1a2e 100%); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 100vh; font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, sans-serif;'; document.body.innerHTML = '
📐 Design Planning
Frame Body
112mm × 87mm × 8mm
Photo Opening
102mm × 77mm × 5mm
Magnet Slots
6.2mm ⌀ × 2.1mm deep
Photo Size
4×3 inch (101.6 × 76.2mm)
';

document.body.style.cssText = 'margin:0; background: #1a1a2e; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 100vh; font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, sans-serif;'; document.body.innerHTML = '
STEP 1
Create the Frame Body
Drag a Box shape onto the workplane.
Set dimensions: 112mm × 87mm × 8mm
';

actions.text: Drag a Box from the shapes panel → Set 112mm × 87mm × 8mm

actions.script:
document.body.style.cssText = 'margin:0; background: #1a1a2e; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 100vh; font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, sans-serif;'; document.body.innerHTML = '
STEP 2
Photo Insert Opening
Create a Hole box: 102mm × 77mm × 5mm
Center it on the frame body using Align tool
Position 1mm from the back face
';

actions.text: Create another Box → Change to Hole → 102mm × 77mm × 5mm → Align Center

actions.script:
document.body.style.cssText = 'margin:0; background: #1a1a2e; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 100vh; font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, sans-serif;'; document.body.innerHTML = '
STEP 3
Photo Retention Lip
Add a thin Hole: 100mm × 75mm × 1mm
at the back surface — prevents photo from falling through
The 1mm lip holds the photo securely
';

document.body.style.cssText = 'margin:0; background: #1a1a2e; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 100vh; font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, sans-serif;'; document.body.innerHTML = '
STEP 4
Magnet Slots
Cylinder → 6.2mm diameter × 2.1mm height
Change to Hole → Position on back face corners
Duplicate (Ctrl+D) for second magnet slot

💡 The 0.2mm extra provides press-fit tolerance
';

actions.text: Add Cylinder holes for magnet slots → 6.2mm ⌀ × 2.1mm → Position at corners

actions.script:
document.body.style.cssText = 'margin:0; background: #1a1a2e; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 100vh; font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, sans-serif;'; document.body.innerHTML = '
STEP 5 (OPTIONAL)
Corner Fillets
Round the corners with 3mm radius cylinders
set as Holes at each corner

Rounded corners look more professional
and feel better in the hand
';

document.body.style.cssText = 'margin:0; background: #1a1a2e; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 100vh; font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, sans-serif;'; document.body.innerHTML = '
STEP 6
Group All Shapes
Select all shapes → Press Ctrl+G to Group

Solid shapes combine • Hole shapes subtract
Result: One solid frame with all cutouts
';

document.body.style.cssText = 'margin:0; background: #1a1a2e; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 100vh; font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, sans-serif;'; document.body.innerHTML = '
STEP 7
Export as STL
Click Export → Select .STL format
Name: MagnetFrame_4x3_v1.stl

Open in your slicer to verify it slices correctly
';

document.body.style.cssText = 'margin:0; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0A0A0F 0%, #1a1a2e 100%); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 100vh; font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, sans-serif;'; document.body.innerHTML = '
🧪 Testing Your Design
Magnet Fit
Press 6×2mm magnets into slots
✓ Snug press-fit = perfect
Photo Fit
Insert 4×3 photo print
✓ Slides in easily, stays put
Too Tight?
Increase hole to 6.3mm
Too Loose?
Decrease to 6.1mm
';

document.body.style.cssText = 'margin:0; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0A0A0F 0%, #1a1a2e 50%, #16213e 100%); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 100vh; font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, sans-serif;'; document.body.innerHTML = '
You Are Now a
Frame Designer! 🎉
Same workflow for every frame: Body → Opening → Lip → Magnets → Group → Export
3D Print Academy — AJ DESIGN
';
